'''Barpotomous Drebble's headquarters''' was the home of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barpotomous Drebble/Legends|Barpotomous Drebble]] in the [[Capital City (Stenos)|capital city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]]. As the leader of a substantial portion of the capital, Drebble ran his business out of the building, and his supporters guarded the building inside and out. Drebble kept the [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddess]], an award he had received for his efforts in aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], inside his headquarters. During the rise of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited Drebble's headquarters and retrieved the Dancing Goddess in order to avert a disaster on the planet [[Godo]].
